EXHIBIT NO. 1
To establish educational and employment programs that will include: 
a) Employment training for 'drop-outs'.
b) Part-time work for students.
c) Employment assistance.
d) Tenant information and counseling.
e) Homeowner information and counseling.
(d) Health and Welfare 
To provide the proper facilities and personnel in Randolph to reach the uninformed, or others in need, of established health and welfare programs and procedure.
2) To establish a nursing home and provide the facilities required for it's efficient operation.
(e) To coordinate, support, and encourage the active participation of all organized community groups having a vested interest in Randolph.
